ai_analysis.behavior_summary: PhotoVault masquerades as a photo storage utility but operates as a sophisticated banking trojan. It silently intercepts all incoming SMS messages to steal OTP codes, overlays phishing screens on top of legitimate banking apps to capture credentials, and exfiltrates harvested data to a hardcoded C2 server. A nested APK dropper component enables second-stage payload delivery.

attack_chain.title: Delivery
attack_chain.detail: APK distributed via phishing SMS or WhatsApp message disguised as a photo app update

attack_chain.title: Persistence
attack_chain.detail: Registers RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED receiver to restart on device reboot

attack_chain.title: OTP Interception
attack_chain.detail: SmsInterceptor.onReceive() calls abortBroadcast() to silently delete SMS before victim sees it, then forwards content to C2

attack_chain.title: Credential Overlay Phishing
attack_chain.detail: AccessibilityOverlayService monitors foreground app; when banking apps are detected, draws a full-screen overlay via SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW to phish credentials

attack_chain.title: Data Exfiltration
attack_chain.detail: Harvested OTPs, contact list, and device ID are AES-encrypted and POSTed to the C2 panel

attack_chain.title: Second-Stage Drop
attack_chain.detail: DexClassLoader loads a secondary payload from assets/payload.apk at runtime, enabling updates without reinstall

recommendations: Block SHA-256 hash at email/SMS gateway immediately
Notify all customers who received the distribution link
Flag C2 domain c2-panel.photovault-cdn.net and IP 185.220.101.47 at firewall/proxy
Alert customers who may have installed the app to reset banking passwords and OTP secrets
Report package com.photovault.secure to Google Play Protect for cross-device blocking

report_markdown:
# Threat Investigation Report — PhotoVault
**Verdict:** 🔴 CRITICAL (87/100) · banking_trojan · Confidence: high
**SHA-256:** `a3f5c8e2d1b4f7a9c0e3b6d8f1a4c7e0b2d5f8a1c4e7f0b3d6a9c2e5f8b1d4`
**Analyzed:** 2026-08-21 14:02 UTC

## Executive Summary
PhotoVault masquerades as a photo storage utility but operates as a sophisticated banking trojan. It silently intercepts all incoming SMS messages to steal OTP codes, overlays phishing screens on top of legitimate banking apps to capture credentials, and exfiltrates harvested data to a hardcoded C2 server.

## Attack Chain
1. **Delivery** — APK distributed via phishing SMS
2. **Persistence** — RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED for reboot survival
3. **OTP Interception** — abortBroadcast() silently deletes SMS
4. **Credential Overlay** — SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW phishing overlay
5. **Exfiltration** — AES-encrypted POST to 185.220.101.47/collect
6. **Second-Stage Drop** — DexClassLoader loads payload.apk

## Risk Score Breakdown
| Triggered Rule | Evidence | Points |
|---|---|---|
| SMS Interception Combo | READ+RECEIVE+SEND_SMS | +30 |
| Accessibility Service | BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE | +20 |
| Nested APK Dropper | assets/payload.apk | +20 |
| Dropper Permission | REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES | +18 |

## Recommended Actions
- Block hash at email/SMS gateway
- Notify affected customers immediately
- Flag C2 infrastructure at firewall
